page.overview:
Who is Gloria Goldberg?

Gloria Goldberg, also known simply as The Author, is a fictional investigator character created by Richard Launius for Chaosium's Cthulhu Mythos board game Arkham Horror in 1987. Since Fantasy Flight Games' acquisition of the property in 2005, they have significantly expanded on her history and exploits. However, it is possible that Chaosium still hold rights to the character, as Gloria does not appear in the latest edition of Arkham Horror (third).

Unlike many of the investigator biographies from Arkham Horror, Gloria Goldberg's backstory has remained largely consistent over the years. She has suffered from nightmarish, apocalyptic visions of sinister entities from beyond our reality destroying the world for as long as she can remember. Over the years, medical and psychiatric treatment has helped her channel these dreams into her fiction, and this has earned her a reputation as a highly-inventive horror writer with a successful career.

In Graham McNeill's 2012 novel Bones of the Yopasi, Gloria is encountered by a group of investigators on the trail of a Cthulhu cultist while on tour in Kingsport promoting her latest book. Although the group keep her in the dark about their true agenda, an invitation to her latest reading - at a local historical society - allows the others to examine occult materials which they would not have otherwise had access to.

Since her first appearance in 1987, Gloria has appeared in most Arkham Horror-related work, including Eldritch Horror, the Arkham Horror Premium Figures line, and Arkham Horror Fiction. A more complete list is given below.
